The structure of MgV4O8F4 (Mg2V8O16F8) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 34 atoms per unit cell distributed over seven independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg in octahedral coordination by four F and two O neighbors, while V centers adopt tetrahedral coordination by three F and one O neighbor. Oxygen and fluorine centers each have two V neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 34 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner-sharing between Mg octahedra and V tetrahedra, and edge-sharing between Mg octahedra.
